## Checklist

- [ ] Tests pass locally (`npm test`).
- [ ] If I touched the scoring engine, I updated/added tests in `test/`.
- [ ] The app still works without a server or network access (no new outbound
      requests; the Content-Security-Policy is unchanged or intentionally
      updated and explained).
- [ ] Untrusted input is rendered as text (`textContent`), never via `innerHTML`.
- [ ] Commit messages use a conventional prefix (`feat:`, `fix:`, `docs:`, …).
